description: Confirm payment of a bill (boleto bancário or concessionária) previously authorized with read_barcode. Requires transactionIdAuthorize from the authorize step.

amount.description: Amount in BRL. Must equal the authorize totalUpdated unless allowChangeValue was true.

barcodeType.description: Barcode category: 1 = concessionária/utility, 2 = bank slip. Defaults to 2.

originalValue.description: Original face value of the bill (from authorize). Optional.

transactionIdAuthorize.description: transactionId returned by read_barcode (the authorize step). Required so Celcoin matches the confirm to the reservation.

valueWithAdditional.description: Value including interest/fine, if any. Optional.

valueWithDiscount.description: Value after discount, if any. Optional.

name: pay_bill
